query: What ethical governance models, consent frameworks, data-access tiers, and local-partner leadership arrangements best balance community rights, legal restrictions, and scholarly openness?

response.query: What ethical governance models, consent frameworks, data-access tiers, and local-partner leadership arrangements best balance community rights, legal restrictions, and scholarly openness?
response.answer: Ethical governance models balance community rights and scholarly openness through stakeholder engagement and consent frameworks. Data-access tiers and local-partner leadership ensure legal compliance and community involvement. Collaborative AI frameworks and data trusts promote equitable data governance.

results.title: Supporting a community-led data infrastructure to build ...
results.content: As a result of this process, we were able to conclude that existing research and data governance models can be transformed if funders, researchers, and community partners embrace important changes in research infrastructure that include adopting collaborative research behaviors and planning research projects *with* communities. **We describe the main findings from our landscape analysis and highlight the key points from our listening and learning process to present elements of what a new model for justice-oriented and equitable community-engaged research can resemble with the focus being on enhancing community ownership of this process to ensure a greater sense of data governance.**. Our roundtable participants uncovered some good models where research institutions train community researchers who have co-conducted focus groups and other aspects of data collection as formal members of funded research teams. Although the interviews we conducted with experts in Native American community-engaged research noted that there is not an existing research entity that oversees data management beyond their own individual Tribe, they did provide several examples of research entities that all have some aspects of the themes identified in our ideal model.
